id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Set the ID of this sensor.

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

key.docs:
**integer**: The keycode for the connected key (Seg0 = 0, Seg1 = 1 etc,). Range is from 0 to 15.

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

tm1637_id.docs:
**:[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the tm1637 that should be used to scan the keys in case you are using multiple devices.

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name for the binary sensor.

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

clk_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin you have the CLK line hooked up to.

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

dio_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin you have the DIO line hooked up to.

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

intensity.docs:
**int**: The intensity with which the TM1637 should drive the outputs. Range is from 0 (least intense) to 7 (the default).

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

inverted.docs:
**bool**: Invert character rendering to the TM1637 so you can physically flip the display around.

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

length.docs:
**int**: The amount of digits your TM1637 is driving. Only used when `inverted: true` Range is from 1 to 6 (the default).

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `1s`.

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the TM1637. See [Rendering Lambda](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#display-tm1637_lambda) for more information.

*See also: [TM1637 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1637#configuration-variables)*
